desc: Derive the fixed-center characterization: for common leaf count \(y\), every neighboring vertex with capacity \(\deg(v)-1\ge y\) may be selected as an intermediate, giving retained size \(1+(y+1)x\).
Find an efficient optimization over all centers and \(y\) using degree-indexed activation in \(O(N)\) time.
Resolve structural edge cases: positive \(x,y\), \(x=1\), \(y=1\), endpoint centers, and deleting all unselected branches/components.
Correct the sweep direction so active vertices represent capacities at least the current threshold.
Verify the corrected implementation against all public samples.
